segments.text: The dragon's fire didn't even scratch my turtle.
A year ago, the whole town laughed at him.
In this town, every kid gets an animal on their tenth birthday. And a number appears above it. Its power.
Wolves get seventy. Eagles get eighty. My tiny turtle got... a one.
Jax got a dragon. Ninety-nine. That same day, Mia picked him.
So I trained. Every morning. Push-ups with Pebble on my back.
I shared my last piece of bread with him. The number stayed one.
Then, the tournament final. Me against Jax. His dragon opened its mouth,
the fire hit Pebble, and the number started climbing. Ten. Five hundred. Nine thousand. Then it broke.
The Saint smiled. The number never showed their power. It showed how much they were loved.
Would you share your last bread?
